newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-INJURED N'GOTTY OUT FOR UP TO A MONTH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED N'GOTTY OUT FOR UP TO A MONTH.

text.p: French international midfielder Bruno N'Gotty, injured during Paris St Germain's 3-0 victory over FC Vaduz in a European Cupwinners Cup match last week, will be out of action for up to a month, PSG doctors said on Tuesday.
N'Gotty, 25, has a torn right calf muscle and will miss PSG's league match in Lyon on Wednesday.
He is also forced out of the French squad for a friendly international between France and Turkey next week in Paris.
The injury came as blow both for PSG and France as their goalkeeper Bernard Lama is also out through injury.
PSG also rested Leonardo from training on Tuesday. The Brazilian was hurt in a league match at Guingamp on Sunday but the seriousness of the injury is not yet known.
